x: In the Field Events our big Irish Guardsman, Pat Ridge, won both the Weight and Discus with very creditable efforts. Charlie Melchior " obliged " once more in the Javelin Throw, and E.
Javelin.—1, Me[illegible]chior (Bel.), 177 ft. 6 ins.; 3, Powell (Bel.), 149 ft. 4 ins. Weight.—1, Ridge (Bel.), 36 ft. 8½ ins.

The javelin event had to be cancelled as our opponents had no performers. Ridge completed a double by winning the discus and shot and S. Joselyn also scored a double by winning both the high and long jumps.
